# CG Groundcare

> CG Groundcare (CGG Groundcare Limited) is a locally run grounds maintenance and landscaping
> company based in Old Kilpatrick, Scotland, serving domestic and commercial clients across
> Glasgow, Edinburgh, Newton Mearns and the surrounding Central Belt. Run by Cameron Gill.

## Services

- Grounds Maintenance — grass cutting, hedge trimming, edging, weeding, seasonal garden care: /services/grounds-maintenance
- Landscaping — garden transformations, artificial grass, decorative gravel, bark, planting: /services/landscaping
- Winter Maintenance — gritting, snow clearance, de-icing: /services/winter-maintenance
- Fencing & Decking — fencing styles, treated timber decking, composite decking: /services/fencing-decking
- Domestic Work — one-off tidy ups to regular maintenance contracts: /services/domestic
- Commercial Work — scheduled contracts for businesses, care homes, schools: /services/commercial

## Details

- Areas served: Glasgow, Edinburgh, Newton Mearns, Old Kilpatrick, and the Central Belt of Scotland
- Contact: 07715 821193, enquiries@cg-groundcare.co.uk
- Free, no-obligation quotes for both domestic and commercial clients
- Fully insured
